desc:
Verity looks friendly, while in reality Verity is NOT really friendly 💀

Survive 7 days to win. Most players don't even make it past Day 1

🪓 Chop trees and mine coal
🔥 Keep the campfire burning
🏠 Build a house
🍎 Roast food
🌙 Hide when the monster comes at night
🎁 Open gift boxes every morning
🤝 Revive your friends before it's too late
🏅 Earn badges for every night you survive

🔔 Update are dropping EVERY FRIDAY!
